title: How much did train ticket prices change in the European Union?
subtitle: While train travel prices soared by 16% in Romania and over 6% in Germany in 2025, countries like Croatia and Lithuania saw fares drop by up to 4%.
textNote: The map is based on the Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices (HICP), which measures changes in consumer prices over time. The indicator shown is the annual average rate of change, comparing the average price index of one calendar year with the average of the previous year. The data follows the ECOICOP classification, base year 2025=100.
